purpose: A bilingual prerequisite graph connecting knowledge points to repository documents, engineering pipelines, learner evidence, and deployment boundaries.
boundary: The graph describes learning dependencies and repository contracts. It does not certify semantic mastery, benchmark performance, or hardware safety.

stages.title: Orientation and tools
stages.exit: Run, inspect, and record a deterministic repository task.
stages.exit_zh: 能够运行、检查并记录一个确定性的仓库任务。

stages.title: Mathematical models
stages.exit: Derive assumptions and verify them numerically.
stages.exit_zh: 能够写出假设、完成推导并用数值实验验证。

stages.title: Robot closed loop
stages.exit: Connect state, dynamics, sensing, control, and safety.
stages.exit_zh: 能够连接状态、动力学、感知、控制与安全约束。

stages.title: Data and learning
stages.exit: Train or execute a policy while retaining data and model provenance.
stages.exit_zh: 能够训练或执行策略，并保留数据与模型溯源信息。

stages.title: Task intelligence
stages.exit: Close the loop on a task and diagnose recovery and failure.
stages.exit_zh: 能够完成任务闭环，并诊断恢复行为与失败原因。

stages.title: Evidence and deployment
stages.exit: Make a promotion decision without crossing the available evidence boundary.
stages.exit_zh: 能够在不越过证据边界的前提下做出晋级决策。

domains.title: Scientific computing
domains.question: Can the experiment be run, inspected, and reproduced?
domains.question_zh: 实验能否运行、检查并复现？

domains.title: Mathematics and uncertainty
domains.question: What assumptions, objectives, and uncertainty define the problem?
domains.question_zh: 问题由哪些假设、目标与不确定性定义？

domains.title: Robot modeling and mechanics
domains.question: How do geometry, motion, force, contact, and actuation relate?
domains.question_zh: 几何、运动、力、接触与驱动如何关联？

domains.title: Sensing, estimation, and control
domains.question: How does a noisy physical loop remain observable, stable, and bounded?
domains.question_zh: 含噪物理闭环如何保持可观测、稳定且受约束？

domains.title: Simulation and data
domains.question: How are worlds, tasks, episodes, and perturbations represented?
domains.question_zh: 世界、任务、轨迹与扰动如何表示？

domains.title: Robot learning
domains.question: How do demonstrations, rewards, language, and embodiment become a policy?
domains.question_zh: 演示、奖励、语言与本体如何形成策略？

domains.title: Prediction, planning, and reasoning
domains.question: How does the system predict consequences, choose actions, and recover?
domains.question_zh: 系统如何预测后果、选择行动并恢复？

domains.title: Embodied task systems
domains.question: How are capabilities composed into manipulation, dexterity, and mobility?
domains.question_zh: 能力如何组合成操作、灵巧性与移动任务？

domains.title: Evaluation and deployment
domains.question: What evidence supports comparison, transfer, and increased physical risk?
domains.question_zh: 哪些证据足以支持比较、迁移与提高物理风险？

nodes.title: Python, NumPy, and tensor shapes
nodes.outcome: Trace array shapes, units, dtypes, and data flow through a robotics program.
nodes.outcome_zh: 能够追踪机器人程序中的数组形状、单位、类型与数据流。
nodes.assessment: Run the lesson examples and explain every input and output shape.
nodes.assessment_zh: 运行课程示例，并解释每个输入输出的形状。

nodes.title: Interfaces, configuration, and tests
nodes.outcome: Express observations, actions, rates, limits, and failure states as explicit contracts.
nodes.outcome_zh: 把观测、动作、频率、限制与失败状态写成明确契约。
nodes.assessment: Validate one schema and demonstrate a rejected invalid input.
nodes.assessment_zh: 验证一个协议，并演示非法输入被拒绝。

nodes.title: Experiment workflow and provenance
nodes.outcome: Record command, commit, environment, seed, data, checkpoint, and metrics together.
nodes.outcome_zh: 同时记录命令、提交、环境、种子、数据、检查点与指标。
nodes.assessment: Re-run one artifact from its receipt without hidden state.
nodes.assessment_zh: 仅凭实验回执重新生成一个产物，不依赖隐藏状态。

nodes.title: Linear algebra and least squares
nodes.outcome: Use vectors, matrices, projections, decompositions, and conditioning correctly.
nodes.outcome_zh: 正确使用向量、矩阵、投影、分解与条件数。
nodes.assessment: Derive and numerically verify a least-squares solution.
nodes.assessment_zh: 推导并数值验证一个最小二乘解。

nodes.title: Probability, estimation, and uncertainty
nodes.outcome: Separate random variables, observations, estimates, uncertainty, and calibration.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分随机变量、观测、估计、不确定性与校准。
nodes.assessment: Compute an estimate and test whether its uncertainty is calibrated.
nodes.assessment_zh: 计算一个估计量，并检验其不确定性是否校准。

nodes.title: Objectives, constraints, and optimization
nodes.outcome: Formulate objectives, constraints, regularization, and termination criteria.
nodes.outcome_zh: 能够形式化目标、约束、正则项与终止条件。
nodes.assessment: Write one constrained objective and diagnose infeasibility or poor conditioning.
nodes.assessment_zh: 写出一个约束目标，并诊断不可行或病态问题。

nodes.title: Numerical stability and discretization
nodes.outcome: Recognize singularity, finite-step error, scaling, and solver sensitivity.
nodes.outcome_zh: 识别奇异性、有限步长误差、尺度与求解器敏感性。
nodes.assessment: Compare two step sizes or damping values and explain the observed error.
nodes.assessment_zh: 比较两种步长或阻尼，并解释误差变化。

nodes.title: Coordinate frames and transform chains
nodes.outcome: State every frame, transform direction, unit, and composition order.
nodes.outcome_zh: 明确每个坐标系、变换方向、单位与复合顺序。
nodes.assessment: Verify a transform round trip and catch one frame-convention error.
nodes.assessment_zh: 验证变换往返一致性，并发现一个坐标约定错误。

nodes.title: SO(3), SE(3), and rotation representations
nodes.outcome: Convert and interpolate rotations while respecting representation limits.
nodes.outcome_zh: 在遵守表示边界的前提下完成旋转转换与插值。
nodes.assessment: Round-trip a pose through two representations and report numerical error.
nodes.assessment_zh: 让位姿经过两种表示往返，并报告数值误差。

nodes.title: Forward kinematics, Jacobians, and IK
nodes.outcome: Relate joint motion to task-space motion and solve bounded IK.
nodes.outcome_zh: 关联关节运动与任务空间运动，并求解有界 IK。
nodes.assessment: Reach a target while logging residual, limits, and singularity handling.
nodes.assessment_zh: 到达目标，同时记录残差、关节限制与奇异处理。

nodes.title: Rigid-body dynamics and integration
nodes.outcome: Distinguish kinematics from dynamics and connect forces to acceleration and integration.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分运动学与动力学，并连接力、加速度与积分。
nodes.assessment: Explain the state update and test energy or tracking behavior under two timesteps.
nodes.assessment_zh: 解释状态更新，并在两种时间步下检查能量或跟踪表现。

nodes.title: Contact, friction, and grasp stability
nodes.title_zh: 接触、摩擦与抓取稳定性
nodes.outcome: Separate collision detection, contact constraints, friction, retention, and task success.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分碰撞检测、接触约束、摩擦、保持与任务成功。
nodes.assessment: Report contact, slip, retention, and lift evidence as separate signals.
nodes.assessment_zh: 分别报告接触、滑移、保持与抬升证据。

nodes.title: Actuation, transmission, and limits
nodes.outcome: Map control inputs through actuators and transmissions to bounded joint or tendon forces.
nodes.outcome_zh: 把控制输入经驱动与传动映射为受限的关节或腱绳力。
nodes.assessment: Trace one command from policy output to executable actuator coordinates.
nodes.assessment_zh: 追踪一条命令从策略输出到可执行驱动坐标。

nodes.title: Sensor models and observation semantics
nodes.title_zh: 传感器模型与观测语义
nodes.outcome: Describe modality, frame, unit, rate, latency, noise, and missing-data behavior.
nodes.outcome_zh: 描述模态、坐标系、单位、频率、延迟、噪声与缺失行为。
nodes.assessment: Write a complete observation schema for one sensor suite.
nodes.assessment_zh: 为一套传感器写出完整观测协议。

nodes.title: Calibration and time synchronization
nodes.outcome: Treat spatial calibration and temporal alignment as measured inputs, not assumptions.
nodes.outcome_zh: 把空间标定与时间对齐作为被测输入，而不是默认假设。
nodes.assessment: Report reprojection error, clock source, and synchronization skew.
nodes.assessment_zh: 报告重投影误差、时钟来源与同步偏差。

nodes.title: Filtering, fusion, and state estimation
nodes.outcome: Fuse observations into a state estimate with explicit uncertainty and stale-data handling.
nodes.outcome_zh: 将观测融合为带显式不确定性与陈旧数据处理的状态估计。
nodes.assessment: Compare estimate error and uncertainty under a controlled perturbation.
nodes.assessment_zh: 在受控扰动下比较估计误差与不确定性。

nodes.title: Feedback, trajectories, and saturation
nodes.outcome: Close a bounded loop with rate, saturation, and anti-windup awareness.
nodes.outcome_zh: 在考虑频率、饱和与抗积分饱和的条件下闭环控制。
nodes.assessment: Tune a controller and report tracking, overshoot, saturation, and failure.
nodes.assessment_zh: 整定控制器并报告跟踪、超调、饱和与失败。

nodes.title: Force, impedance, and compliant interaction
nodes.outcome: Reason about motion and force together during uncertain contact.
nodes.outcome_zh: 在不确定接触中同时推理运动与力。
nodes.assessment: Demonstrate bounded interaction under a contact or force perturbation.
nodes.assessment_zh: 在接触或力扰动下展示受限交互。

nodes.title: Rates, watchdogs, state machines, and safety
nodes.title_zh: 频率、看门狗、状态机与安全
nodes.outcome: Design stale-command rejection, limits, stop states, logging, and human authority.
nodes.outcome_zh: 设计陈旧命令拒绝、限制、停止状态、日志与人工权限。
nodes.assessment: Inject a fault and verify the system reaches the intended bounded state.
nodes.assessment_zh: 注入故障并验证系统进入预期的受限状态。

nodes.title: URDF, MJCF, assets, and model provenance
nodes.outcome: Build a model with explicit units, inertials, joints, actuators, sensors, and licenses.
nodes.outcome_zh: 构建单位、惯量、关节、驱动、传感器与许可证明确的模型。
nodes.assessment: Load, inspect, step, and export one model without silent defaults.
nodes.assessment_zh: 加载、检查、步进并导出模型，不依赖隐式默认值。

nodes.title: Scene dynamics, contacts, and observability
nodes.title_zh: 场景动力学、接触与可观测性
nodes.outcome: Connect model parameters to contacts, sensors, controller inputs, and logged state.
nodes.outcome_zh: 把模型参数连接到接触、传感器、控制器输入与日志状态。
nodes.assessment: Run a deterministic scene and inspect contact and sensor evidence.
nodes.assessment_zh: 运行确定性场景，并检查接触与传感器证据。

nodes.title: Task definition, reset, perturbation, and randomization
nodes.title_zh: 任务定义、复位、扰动与随机化
nodes.outcome: Define success, failure, reset distribution, perturbations, and coverage before collection.
nodes.outcome_zh: 采集前定义成功、失败、复位分布、扰动与覆盖率。
nodes.assessment: Show deterministic replay and a separately seeded robustness sweep.
nodes.assessment_zh: 展示确定性回放与独立随机种子的鲁棒性扫描。

nodes.title: Episode schema and multimodal alignment
nodes.title_zh: Episode 协议与多模态对齐
nodes.outcome: Represent observations, actions, language, timestamps, tasks, and terminal states consistently.
nodes.outcome_zh: 一致表示观测、动作、语言、时间戳、任务与终止状态。
nodes.assessment: Validate one episode and reject missing, misaligned, or incompatible fields.
nodes.assessment_zh: 验证一条 episode，并拒绝缺失、错位或不兼容字段。

nodes.title: Data quality, coverage, and leakage-free splits
nodes.title_zh: 数据质量、覆盖与无泄漏切分
nodes.outcome: Measure data integrity, task coverage, distribution shift, and split leakage.
nodes.outcome_zh: 测量数据完整性、任务覆盖、分布偏移与切分泄漏。
nodes.assessment: Produce a datasheet and reproduce a split from recorded identifiers.
nodes.assessment_zh: 生成数据说明，并从记录标识复现切分。

nodes.title: Neural networks and optimization loops
nodes.outcome: Trace forward, loss, gradient, update, validation, and overfitting behavior.
nodes.outcome_zh: 追踪前向、损失、梯度、更新、验证与过拟合行为。
nodes.assessment: Train a small model and diagnose its learning curves.
nodes.assessment_zh: 训练一个小模型并诊断学习曲线。

nodes.title: Transformers and multimodal representations
nodes.outcome: Track token, image, state, mask, and temporal dimensions through attention.
nodes.outcome_zh: 追踪注意力中的 token、图像、状态、掩码与时间维度。
nodes.assessment: Trace one multimodal batch through an attention block without shape ambiguity.
nodes.assessment_zh: 无歧义地追踪一批多模态数据经过注意力模块。

nodes.title: Behavior cloning and covariate shift
nodes.title_zh: 行为克隆与协变量偏移
nodes.outcome: Separate supervised action fit from closed-loop performance and recovery.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分监督动作拟合、闭环表现与恢复能力。
nodes.assessment: Compare offline loss with closed-loop task success on fixed episodes.
nodes.assessment_zh: 在固定 episode 上比较离线损失与闭环任务成功。

nodes.title: Action spaces, chunks, tokens, and diffusion
nodes.title_zh: 动作空间、分块、Token 与扩散
nodes.outcome: Match policy outputs to control semantics, horizon, rate, and embodiment limits.
nodes.outcome_zh: 让策略输出与控制语义、时域、频率及本体限制匹配。
nodes.assessment: Decode one policy output to executable commands and check units and bounds.
nodes.assessment_zh: 把一次策略输出解码为可执行命令，并检查单位与边界。

nodes.title: Vision-language-action policies
nodes.outcome: Connect visual-language grounding to temporally valid robot actions.
nodes.outcome_zh: 把视觉语言对齐连接到时序有效的机器人动作。
nodes.assessment: Run language and vision ablations and report closed-loop success separately.
nodes.assessment_zh: 执行语言与视觉消融，并单独报告闭环成功率。

nodes.title: Reinforcement learning and post-training
nodes.outcome: Define state, action, reward, termination, exploration, and safety constraints explicitly.
nodes.outcome_zh: 显式定义状态、动作、奖励、终止、探索与安全约束。
nodes.assessment: Reproduce a seeded run and separate reward from task success and safety.
nodes.assessment_zh: 复现带种子的运行，并区分奖励、任务成功与安全。

nodes.title: Cross-embodiment adaptation and robot foundation models
nodes.title_zh: 跨本体适配与机器人基础模型
nodes.outcome: Make observation and action semantics explicit across datasets and robots.
nodes.outcome_zh: 明确不同数据集与机器人之间的观测和动作语义。
nodes.assessment: Report adapter coverage and per-embodiment results without pooling away failures.
nodes.assessment_zh: 报告适配覆盖与分本体结果，不用汇总掩盖失败。

nodes.title: MDP, POMDP, reward, and belief
nodes.outcome: State what is observed, hidden, controlled, rewarded, and terminal.
nodes.outcome_zh: 明确可观测、隐藏、可控、奖励与终止变量。
nodes.assessment: Write a task model and identify one source of partial observability.
nodes.assessment_zh: 写出任务模型，并指出一个部分可观测来源。

nodes.title: Motion planning and trajectory optimization
nodes.outcome: Distinguish path, trajectory, dynamics, collision, feasibility, and feedback.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分路径、轨迹、动力学、碰撞、可行性与反馈。
nodes.assessment: Generate a feasible candidate and verify it with independent constraints.
nodes.assessment_zh: 生成可行候选，并用独立约束验证。

nodes.title: World models and predictive rollouts
nodes.outcome: Separate one-step fit, multi-step rollout, uncertainty, and planning utility.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分单步拟合、多步 rollout、不确定性与规划效用。
nodes.assessment: Report rollout error by horizon and downstream planned-task success.
nodes.assessment_zh: 按时域报告 rollout 误差与下游规划任务成功。

nodes.title: Task and motion composition
nodes.outcome: Compose symbolic goals, skill preconditions, geometric feasibility, and execution feedback.
nodes.outcome_zh: 组合符号目标、技能前置、几何可行性与执行反馈。
nodes.assessment: Execute one typed plan and retain precondition and failure events.
nodes.assessment_zh: 执行一条类型化计划，并保留前置条件与失败事件。

nodes.title: Embodied reasoning, monitoring, and recovery
nodes.outcome: Ground plans in current state and trigger bounded recovery or replanning.
nodes.outcome_zh: 让计划基于当前状态，并触发受限恢复或重规划。
nodes.assessment: Inject an execution failure and measure detection, replan, and recovery.
nodes.assessment_zh: 注入执行失败，并测量检测、重规划与恢复。

nodes.title: Manipulation and imitation-learning systems
nodes.outcome: Close perception, approach, contact, motion, task verification, and recovery.
nodes.outcome_zh: 闭合感知、接近、接触、运动、任务验证与恢复。
nodes.assessment: Report task success and a stage-resolved failure taxonomy.
nodes.assessment_zh: 报告任务成功率与按阶段拆解的失败分类。

nodes.title: Dexterity, retargeting, and teleoperation
nodes.title_zh: 灵巧操作、重定向与遥操作
nodes.outcome: Separate human-pose tracking, robot realizability, command admission, contact, and task evidence.
nodes.outcome_zh: 区分人手跟踪、机器人可实现性、命令准入、接触与任务证据。
nodes.assessment: Validate geometry, temporal quality, safety admission, and task outcome independently.
nodes.assessment_zh: 独立验证几何、时序质量、安全准入与任务结果。

nodes.title: Navigation and mobile embodied agents
nodes.title_zh: 导航与移动具身智能体
nodes.outcome: Connect localization, mapping assumptions, planning, control, collision, and recovery.
nodes.outcome_zh: 连接定位、地图假设、规划、控制、碰撞与恢复。
nodes.assessment: Report goal, collision, localization, replan, and recovery metrics together.
nodes.assessment_zh: 同时报告到达、碰撞、定位、重规划与恢复指标。

nodes.title: Locomotion, balance, and humanoid systems
nodes.title_zh: 运动控制、平衡与人形系统
nodes.outcome: Treat tracking, balance, contacts, falls, recovery, and hardware limits as separate gates.
nodes.outcome_zh: 把跟踪、平衡、接触、跌倒、恢复与硬件限制作为独立门禁。
nodes.assessment: Pass motion-only simulation and safety regression before increasing physical risk.
nodes.assessment_zh: 提高物理风险前先通过纯运动仿真与安全回归。

nodes.title: Task metrics and failure taxonomies
nodes.outcome: Align metrics with task definitions and retain stage-specific failures.
nodes.outcome_zh: 让指标与任务定义对齐，并保留阶段级失败。
nodes.assessment: Publish numerator, denominator, episode protocol, and failure categories.
nodes.assessment_zh: 发布分子、分母、episode 协议与失败类别。

nodes.title: Generalization, robustness, and distribution shift
nodes.title_zh: 泛化、鲁棒性与分布偏移
nodes.outcome: Define held-out factors and perturbations before interpreting robustness.
nodes.outcome_zh: 解释鲁棒性前先定义留出因素与扰动。
nodes.assessment: Compare in-distribution and held-out results under the same protocol.
nodes.assessment_zh: 在同一协议下比较分布内与留出结果。

nodes.title: Statistics, ablations, and negative results
nodes.outcome: Report variability, seeds, ablations, compute, and unsuccessful runs without selective omission.
nodes.outcome_zh: 报告波动、种子、消融、计算量与失败运行，不选择性省略。
nodes.assessment: Reproduce one comparison and explain what the protocol cannot establish.
nodes.assessment_zh: 复现一项比较，并说明协议无法证明什么。

nodes.title: System identification and Sim-to-Real
nodes.outcome: Measure parameter mismatch and pass replay, perturbation, HIL, and shadow gates in order.
nodes.outcome_zh: 测量参数失配，并依次通过回放、扰动、半实物与影子门禁。
nodes.assessment: Produce a promotion decision with explicit unmet gates and rollback conditions.
nodes.assessment_zh: 生成包含未满足门禁与回滚条件的晋级决策。

nodes.title: Hardware evidence and operational safety
nodes.outcome: Keep synthetic, simulation, HIL, shadow, and real-hardware evidence distinct.
nodes.outcome_zh: 严格区分合成、仿真、半实物、影子与真实硬件证据。
nodes.assessment: Require authorized supervision, bounded commands, stop paths, logs, and task evidence.
nodes.assessment_zh: 要求授权监督、受限命令、停止路径、日志与任务证据。
